/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 npx prettier --write src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts src/conversationListMessages.test.ts src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts && git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --cached --stat && git diff --stat'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add -A && git commit -m "fix(transport): satisfy conversation list CI checks" && git push origin HEAD'
